page.overview:
Who is William Afton?

William Afton, also known as the Room 1280 Patient, is an infamous serial killer and the overarching antagonist of the Fazbear Frights series.

William is burned to a crisp. He only vaguely resembles a human in shape, as he has a head, a torso, two arms, and two legs. The burning was so pervasive and complete that William's charred skeleton is fully visible. He has no hair, and the fire has burned away so many layers of skin that it's just an ashy, translucent covering. The fire has also dried all the moisture from William's skin, resulting in extensive cracks that reveal uncharred tissue. The cracks also reveal functioning organs, such as his dried and blackened heart, his heat-shriveled lungs, his seared kidneys, and his carbonized bladder. William's face is missing, with a hole in his skull where his nose used to be, dark cavernous pits lacking eyes, and a gaping toothless mouth without lips. Cracks in his burned cranium exposes bits of his gray brain. William has blood flowing in his veins, which looks like scorched worms that creep above and through his toasted tissues, pulsing under his skin and around his skeleton. He has no ears but can still hear.

In the Stitchwraith Stingers, he looks similar to his previous appearance, but his bones were reformed to add the shape of two rabbit ears and a clawed arm.

Springtrap in this story has a similar appearance to his game counterpart. It is a rabbit animatronic with yellow-green fur, white eyes, and green heavy eyelids. Springtrap has torn ears and fur that is ripped or chewed away in dozens of places on its body and limbs. Where its fur it torn, metal pieces of its animatronic structure are revealed, such as exposed wires linked to an oxidized metal frame and reddish areas which Hudson discovers is bodily tissue. Springtrap’s broken tooth-filled mouth has a tooth knocked out of it. This Springtrap is different in that, below a jagged lower edge of its fur, it has exposed ankle bones.

Also known as: Afton, Purple Guy.
